name: Quail Egg
description: Quail eggs (Coturnix coturnix) represent a nutrient-dense avian reproductive cell matrix, exhibiting a superior micronutrient-to-caloric ratio compared to Gallus gallus domesticus eggs. The structure consists of a highly emulsified yolk fraction rich in phospholipids and lecithin, enclosed by a viscous albumin matrix containing potent antimicrobial proteins. This food serves as an elite biological reservoir for neuro-cellular precursors and hematopoiesis-stimulating factors, facilitating optimized metabolic homeostasis and immunological resilience through refined biochemical signaling.
macroIntro: An ultra-dense protein and lipid architecture characterized by a lack of glycemic substrate and extreme bioavailability.
microIntro: A highly concentrated repository of B-complex vitamins, bioavailable iron, and neuroprotective phospholipids.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: Clean thermodynamic energy derived from long-chain lipid oxidation and complete amino acid proteolysis.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: A complete profile of essential amino acids required for rapid cellular repair and myofibrillar protein synthesis.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Lipid fraction rich in phospholipids, including lecithin, essential for neuronal signal transduction and plasma membrane integrity.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Negligible carbohydrate content, ensuring absolute blood glucose stability and zero insulinemic response.

microNutrients.name: Choline
microNutrients.description: A fundamental precursor for acetylcholine, the primary neurotransmitter involved in cognitive function and memory consolidation.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B12
microNutrients.description: Vital for neural myelin sheath maintenance and erythropoiesis, preventing cellular energy decline.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin)
microNutrients.description: Crucial coenzyme involved in electron transport chains for ATP production and maintenance of ocular health.

microNutrients.name: Iron
microNutrients.description: High-bioavailability iron critical for oxygen transport within the heme-protein complex of erythrocytes.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin A
microNutrients.description: Essential retinol precursor for ocular photosensitivity and systemic immune cell proliferation.

microNutrients.name: Selenium
microNutrients.description: Key mineral cofactor for glutathione peroxidase, protecting thyroid and cellular lipids from oxidative stress.

healthBenefits: Neuro-Cognitive Architecture Enhancement: Synergistic action of choline and phospholipids boosts synaptic signal processing and long-term memory maintenance.
Hematopoiesis and Oxygen Dynamics: Optimized iron and B12 density directly elevates red blood cell maturation, effectively correcting systemic hypoxic fatigue.
Immunomodulatory Histamine Regulation: Bioactive ovomucoid proteins inhibit inflammatory cascades, providing potential clinical support in managing allergic response phenotypes.
Structural Tissue Regeneration: High-quality amino acid matrices provide immediate substrates for the repair of damaged tissue and accelerating metabolic recovery post-exertion.
precautionsIntro: While biologically superior, industrial and home-based consumption requires adherence to specific protocols:
precautions: Microbiological Risk (Salmonella): Pathogenic contamination remains a systemic risk regardless of avian species; mandatory thermal inactivation at 74C is required.
Hyper-responsive Lipid Profiles: The elevated cholesterol density in the yolk fraction requires quantitative monitoring by individuals with established cardiovascular hyper-reactivity.
Proteomic Cross-reactivity: Individuals with IgE-mediated sensitivities to standard egg albumins may demonstrate cross-reactivity with the homologous proteins found in quail eggs.
